name: com.uee03.pretzel.setup
description: The Project Setup window: project info, folder presets, scene templates, and install of Pretzel modules and curated third-party packages. Needs no other Pretzel module.

samples.description: Add your own Project Setup tab and Main tab section with IPretzelTab and IPretzelMainSection.

Click Rush: a complete small game with no DI container. Services live in a ScriptableObject filled by a bootstrap, with Events, Scenes, Data and Preferences, UI Toolkit screens, tests and scene builder.
